enrichment.summary: Configures strict inbound anti-spam settings to quarantine phishing, high-confidence spam, spam, and bulk emails, with a 30-day quarantine retention and zero-hour auto purge enabled.
enrichment.rationale: Helps organisations minimise the risk of phishing attacks and spam by applying stringent filtering policies, ensuring potentially harmful or unwanted emails are quarantined for review.
enrichment.userImpact: Users may notice fewer spam or phishing emails in their inbox and can access quarantined emails if needed.
